# {{ site.company_legal }} ({{ site.name }} Education)

> {{ site.meta_description }}

WinPlus is a global talent development platform for high school students and their families, serving {{ site.area_served | join(", ") }}. One dedicated consultant guides each student from Grade 9 to university acceptance across three service lines: admissions counseling, research & internships, and experience enrichment.

{% endfor %}- [How we work]({{ site_url }}/how-it-works.html): Free strategy session, profile assessment, multi-year roadmap, profile building, applications and decision support.
